target_comment: Keep the Apple Silicon stack on the versions resolved by the v0.2.7 release; loose specifiers can drift to newer MLX versions that break transcription from worker threads.

adjacent_dependabot_evidence.purpose: corroborates that Dependabot proposes individual member updates inside the coordinated family

maintainer_comment_on_pr34: The maintainer described the mlx extra as hand-frozen/coordinated, said the standard checks do not install the extra, and said the family is tested on-device.
bounded_conclusion: The NumPy change is an independent bot proposal against one member of an exact-pinned family whose target source explicitly documents coordinated-version intent.
claim_limits: This does not prove NumPy 2.4.6 is incompatible with the rest of the family.
This does not establish that every family member must always move atomically.
Maintainer comments are not used as sole technical evidence.
